<thought>Based on the measured resistances, the network can be represented as a tree centered on node N_b1 with four series resistors, plus two additional direct resistors that create parallel paths matching the lower measured values. The inferred resistor values (rounded to three decimal places) are:
- R1: 11.667 Ω between A and N_b1
- R2: 29.697 Ω between B and N_b1
- R3: 5.000 Ω between N_b1 and X1
- R4: 13.333 Ω between N_b1 and X2
- R5: 11.112 Ω between A and X1 (parallel to the A‑N_b1‑X1 path)
- R6: 26.440 Ω between B and X2 (parallel to the B‑N_b1‑X2 path)

All other measured resistances are exactly the sums of the series paths through N_b1, confirming this topology.
